description.value: Havana is a Cuban-inspired restaurant and bar on Commercial Drive, one of Vancouver's most-cycled streets, blending authentic Latin flavours with Pacific Northwest ingredients and East Vancouver craft beers. The venue features a year-round covered patio described as an iconic neighbourhood hangout, sheltered from seasonal elements and well-suited for groups. Part of a small family of related Vancouver venues, Havana is known for its lively atmosphere, innovative cocktail program, and commitment to fresh, locally sourced ingredients.
